curriculum.name: person_on_call_at
curriculum.goal: Given a time, return the person on the first call scheduled at that time.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END

curriculum.name: count_calls_with
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return how many calls there are with that person.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END

post_turns.text: REQUEST how many calls with the person on my 12 call

post_turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time={time}
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END
